_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Recording palette actions are hidden in an archived conversation. The test seeded and archived a conversation {{ARCHIVED}}. To "open the recording palette", every time a step says so: press_key "k" with modifier "Control", wait for the command palette input (".command-palette-input") to be visible, and fill it with "Record audio" (all three, every time). "The palette item X" is the command palette item whose title is exactly X; select it with '.command-palette-item[data-test-title="X"]' (the page keeps that attribute equal to the item's title, so "Record audio" does not match "Record audio and screen"). The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible.
2. If the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it.
3. Click the button "View Archived", then click ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"{{ARCHIVED}}\"]".
4. The message input should become hidden.
5. Open the recording palette. There must be no palette item "Record audio" and no palette item "Record audio and screen" (both counts 0).
